findings.claim: Page title: “Mark Carney Is on the 2026 TIME100 List.” Profile by ECB President Christine Lagarde. It credits Carney with designing banking/finance regulatory framework during 2008 crisis; first non-British Bank of England governor; raising Brexit consequences and financial-stability risks of climate change; and “first to conceptualize the breaking point of multilateralism” after becoming Canada PM. Lagarde says she trusts he will reinvent cooperation among the willing. This is TIME100 Most Influential People coverage, not the market’s Person of the Year cover/article. Captured TIME100 list body embeds this exact profile path/title/date; the displayed image is a TIME100 portrait, not a POY cover.
Embedded official collection data lists title Mark Carney; link `/collection/100-most-influential-people/2026/mark-carney/`; category Leaders; publication date 2026-04-15T11:00:00Z.
findings.published: List for 2026; page data for Carney says 2026-04-15T11:00:00Z.
findings.source: TIME 2026 TIME100 collection page (primary body; URL discovery source)

findings.claim: TIME Editor in Chief Sam Jacobs describes TIME100 as editorial selection with no single influence metric, led by stories shaping the world; says editors/reporters/sources are polled and recommendations reviewed. In same essay says Carney and Denmark’s Mette Frederiksen saw popularity increase at home as they stood up to Trump.
